name: BSV Broadcaster
description: Documentation for BSV Broadcaster, a BSV transaction broadcast and status-tracking API, and the read-only calls on its public API server.

tools.name: filter-api-routes
tools.description: Open the API reference filtered to routes whose method, path, summary or description contain the query.

tools.name: get-transaction-status
tools.description: Look up the current status of a BSV transaction by txid on this BSV Broadcaster API server.

tools.name: get-policy
tools.description: Read the current fee and size policy (ARC-compatible) of this BSV Broadcaster API server.

tools.name: get-health
tools.description: Check liveness and chain-tip height of this BSV Broadcaster API server.
